answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 6132 Country: United Kingdom Title: I have a question about education. Is it allowed for a muslim woman to studdy in colleges and univertsities where boys and girls are together, in case that there are no education institutes for woman only? Question: salam I have a question about education. Is it allowed for a muslim woman to studdy in colleges and univertsities where boys and girls are together, in case that there are no education institutes for woman only? Answer ID: 6132 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 999/969=D/1429) It is allowable provided it is with hijab and there is protection from mischiefs and evils. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
